{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check if missingness in flipper_length_mm is related to species
missing_flipper = penguins[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]
print('Penguins with missing flipper length by species:\n', missing_flipper['species'].value_counts())

# Check distribution of flipper length for each species, excluding missing values
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print('\nMean flipper length by species:\n', mean_flipper_by_species)

# Confirm the species with highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')"}
